notes.title: A small guide for DEAD ZONE players
notes.content:
[i][b]If you purchased DEAD ZONE. Thanks a lot![/b][/i]
At the start of the game, you are thrown to random points on the territory of the game map with a pistol and a small amount of ammunition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/3ffe21b5f84d387a0f7ffe2eba2688491ce0ee8b.jpg[/img]

To load your weapon, you will need to double-click on the weapon itself and remove the magazine, then move the available cartridges to the magazine itself and place it back in the magazine slot of the weapon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/ed2a15502741d87957678e7a93ae4939b8c04267.jpg[/img]

With the additional magazines with cartridges available, we can automatically reload the weapon on the R key
At the beginning of the game, all that the game requires from you is the activity of gathering, for crafting starting items. Such as;

- Backpack - the main item of importance, for storing items. Requires 25 textile found on the map to craft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/7b5e46c5a3987086d2147bda106c89ae51bdd0cb.jpg[/img]

- [b]Cleaver [/b]- basic ax for cutting wood . Requires one wood and 3 metal junk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/e99b1150f978018efcb6620ab7f7810b083ffe08.jpg[/img]

- [b]Adjustable wrench[/b] - an item that will help you extract scrap metal from broken cars. Requires 3 metal junk

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/afbb3e5d5246745afd3ca85780c6c3bdf6b16a23.jpg[/img]

- A [b]sleeping bag[/b] is an item that serves as a checkpoint for the player. It is the spawn point after death. Requires 20 textile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/3c254d89b655e9ad0cc38686a952fd31d760605a.jpg[/img]

- [b]Sawmill [/b]- installation, which has an important role in construction. Processes available wood into planks and beams required to build a house and craft some items. Requires 10 metal junk

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/8a82a394a24bc3efd268f18d75137cd133abc725.jpg[/img]

- The [b]workbench [/b]is the main point for crafting most of the things you have learned and repairing them. Requires 4 bars, 10 boards, and one full kerosene lamp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/3a0cba134688ce3eadb23db909679ca967374d6c.jpg[/img]

- [b]Constuction Plan[/b] - A blueprint that contains the elements of the house that you can build with the required resources. Requires wood and textile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/c17fa88ce10abc298c3b5b39f90e2fd641d18598.jpg[/img]

- [b]Small Cooker[/b] - a small gas stove that uses gas cylinders as fuel, which can either be obtained or bought from a merchant. Requires 5 metal junk and 2 electronic junk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/b97d947136a2f47973353be24ee924defd08d0c8.jpg[/img]

[b]Advice![/b] In the beginning, it is best to create a wrench to extract metal from cars, to create a sawmill in which you will process wood into planks, which will contribute to the extraction of the necessary types of wood to create a house and craft some items, such as a workbench, boxes, etc. When doing this activity, do not forget to inspect the area for textiles, because it is required to create a building plan.

Initial resources such as wood and metal can be collected from stumps and metal structures found on the territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/a5cf5c23907f9e2e1ab161624497619634421468.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416492/30d7c50ab9d2be210de991151d1c85bcbaa85f48.jpg[/img]

At the same time, all of you should not forget both hunger and thirst.
[i][b]Water [/b][/i]can be obtained by finding a pond or barrels of water located on the map, where you can both drink directly and collect water found in a container, which will quench your thirst more productively.
[i][b]Food[/b][/i], on the other hand, can be found in apartments, kiosks or other places in the form of canned food, but also no one forbids hunting animals, from harmless chickens to aggressive bears.
Also, do not forget that many items have durability, so if you do not want to craft a new one, the item can be repaired.
Go to a workbench crafted or found on the map and right click on the item and select repair, if you have the right amount to repair resources, the weapon will have full durability
